title: Maximum Palindromes After Operations
summary: Given a string array, you can swap any two characters from different strings any number of times.
statement: Given a string array, you can swap any two characters from different strings any number of times. Determine the maximum number of palindromes that can be formed in the array after performing these operations.
constraints: words is a nonempty list of nonempty lowercase strings.
Characters may be swapped arbitrarily within or between strings, but every string length stays fixed.
Return the maximum number of strings that can simultaneously be palindromes.
reference_solution:
def maximum_palindromes_after_swaps(words):
    counts=Counter(''.join(words));pairs=sum(value//2 for value in counts.values());answer=0
    for word in sorted(words,key=len):
        needed=len(word)//2
        if needed>pairs:break
        pairs-=needed;answer+=1
    return answer

        needed=(len(word)+1)//2
        if needed>pairs:break
